verdict.rationale: Orrick's UK venture page explicitly states it advises 'companies and investors at all stages of growth,' and the IP due-diligence page notes representing 'both buyers and sellers,' plus market-standard tools like the Convertible Note Term Sheet Creator suggest cross-side market-terms expertise. However, evidence is thin and regional (mainly UK), with no dedicated global 'VC fund-side' practice page or explicit claim of representing institutional investors as fund clients across jurisdictions. Missing for 10: explicit fund/investor-side client roster or practice page, global (not just UK) statements of dual-side representation, and independent confirmation of investor-side market-term expertise.
